review.assessment: The change introduces src/eval.rs from scratch, implementing a tokenizer/parser that correctly separates multiplicative terms but incorrectly combines additive terms by iterating through operators in reverse order. This right-to-left processing breaks standard left-associativity for chained addition and subtraction operations.

findings.defect: Additive operators (+, -) are combined right-to-left instead of left-to-right due to the .rev() iterator, yielding incorrect results for multi-operator expressions.
